notes.title: Patch 01: Tree cutting, winter snow, rabbits, ...
notes.notes:
[u][b]In this update, a lot of new things.[/b][/u]

- Added trees to cut
- Added animation for cutting wood
- Collect twigs with cut trees
- Collect long sticks with cut trees
- Added board storage
- Store up to 24 boards per built storage
- Changed character camera placement
- Bug of the gourd which empties at certain times fixed
- Added bunnies
- Rabbits run away if you approach
- Added snow in winter (December and January)
- Added ice instead of water
- Added plants and rocks in the sea
- Improvement of the flora in the plain

notes.title: Map expansion and new plants
notes.notes: In this update, the map is greatly enlarged with new spaces, and a small lake in the center of the map to facilitate the use of the water bottle. You also have the possibility of finding 4 new plants. (Fern, white clover, cleavers, lupine)

notes.title: February update
notes.notes:
In this update, you have the option to build a grow box to grow blueberries or blackberries in it.
A brand new display of the construction menu has been made. Feel free to share your ideas for improvement in the community HUB.
Thank you all and good game.
